reason: The cited evidence shows Sn suppresses pest oxidation and improves scale adhesion in Nb-silicide-based alloys (E1, E2), but none of the passages evaluate equiatomic HfNbTaTiZr or provide data on mechanical properties after Sn addition, leaving the transferability and mechanical-impact premises unsupported.
premises: Sn addition suppresses pest oxidation in refractory alloys

~5 at.% Sn is sufficient for oxidation improvement without forming detrimental phases
